So, I think if the sets of characters at even positions in s1 and s2 match and the sets of characters at odd positions in s1 and s2 match then we can make the strings equal. I'm going to write code to compare these.","python_code":"class Solution:
    def checkStrings(self, s1: str, s2: str) -> bool:
        even_s1 = [s1[i] for i in range(0, len(s1), 2)]
        odd_s1 = [s1[i] for i in range(1, len(s1), 2)]
        even_s2 = [s2[i] for i in range(0, len(s2), 2)]
        odd_s2 = [s2[i] for i in range(1, len(s2), 2)]

        return sorted(even_s1) == sorted(even_s2) and sorted(odd_s1) == sorted(odd_s2)"}
